title: Prenatal-to-Age-Three Health in Austin
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   City leaders engaged in a "Meet and Greet" to discuss early childhood development.
*   The focus was on initiatives supporting a strong prenatal to age three agenda.
*   Hosted in collaboration with the National League of Cities Institute for Youth, Education and Families, and Austin Public Health.
*   This was an informal gathering for discussion and information sharing, with no policy actions taken.
